Hi Mayank,

I saw your extensive work driving financial strategy, risk management and cash optimization at Elior. With 18 years in finance, you know how critical accurate, auditable data is. I’ve observed that many CFOs still manage exceptions in spreadsheets, which leaves no clear audit trail and adds manual effort. Our solution lets operations teams automate those reconciliation‑heavy tasks, giving you real‑time visibility and eliminating error‑prone spreadsheets. Could we explore how this could streamline your reporting and risk controls?

Best,
Zamp
